Compare energy costs for 10,000 annual miles. A gasoline car gets 28 mpg with fuel at $3.30/gallon. An EV uses 0.28 kWh per mile with electricity at $0.13/kWh; that usage already includes charging losses. Ignoring all other costs, how much lower is the EV's annual energy cost? Round to the nearest cent.
explanation: Gas cost = 10,000 ÷ 28 × $3.30 = $1,178.57. EV cost = 10,000 × 0.28 × $0.13 = $364.00. Subtract unrounded costs to obtain $814.57 saved.
